heading: Purposes
lead: The purposes of the corporation are, through organization and cooperation with the Department of the Navy—

tree.text: to encourage and aid American young people to develop an interest and skill in basic seamanship and in its naval adaptations;
to train them in seagoing skills; and
to teach them patriotism, courage, self-reliance, and kindred virtues.
